name = args.label or args.phase
        (PHASE_DIR / (name + ".json")).write_text(
            json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
evidence.reason: The central artifact write uses `args.label or args.phase` as the sole filename. For a matrix boundary run with `--label`, this writes only `<label>.json`; the separately dispatched observe phase reads the canonical `<case>.json`, so on a clean guest the boundary evidence is missing and on a reused guest it can be stale. This is an ordinary correctness bug, and the smallest compatible fix is to also write the canonical matrix case artifact when a label is supplied.
